faqs.question: What massage options are available with this deal at Head&Skin Health Spa?
faqs.answer: Head&Skin Health Spa offers two options: a 60-Minute Deep Tissue or Swedish Massage with Hot Stones and Essential Oils, or a 90-Minute Meridian Massage with Rose Oil and Hot Stones. Both options incorporate hot stone treatment as part of the session.

faqs.question: How are hot stones incorporated into the Deep Tissue/Swedish Or 90-Min Meridian Massage with Hot Stones treatments?
faqs.answer: Hot stones are used as part of the massage treatments at Head&Skin Health Spa, as confirmed by multiple customers. This applies across both the 60-minute and 90-minute service options listed in this deal.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the 60-minute and 90-minute sessions in the Deep Tissue/Swedish Or 90-Min Meridian Massage with Hot Stones deal?
faqs.answer: The 60-minute session focuses on Deep Tissue or Swedish massage techniques using hot stones and essential oils, while the 90-minute session is a Meridian Massage that uses rose oil and hot stones. The 90-minute option provides an additional 30 minutes of treatment time and a different massage modality.

faqs.question: Where is Head&Skin Health Spa located?

faqs.question: Can two people receive a massage together at Head&Skin Health Spa?
faqs.answer: Yes, Head&Skin Health Spa offers couples massage sessions where two people are treated simultaneously in the same space, as confirmed by multiple customers.
